seismic_authoritative.source: USGS ASCE 7-22 web service, siteClass=BC (Vs30 760 m/s)
seismic_authoritative.note: Authoritative for the 2% in 50 yr (~2475 yr) level. The 475 and 975 yr columns have no equivalent point service and remain contour-derived, so they keep the 0.01 g band discretisation caveat and are approximate.

caveats: Values are sampled at a single facility point, not intersected with the building footprint. Adequate where the hazard's correlation length greatly exceeds the building (seismic, lightning); a known limitation for wildfire (270 m) and for flood once added.
Seismic values are reference-rock (site class BC, Vs30 760 m/s) and are therefore a systematic underestimate at soft-soil sites.
Exposure only. No vulnerability or consequence term is applied, so these columns are not risk estimates.
